description: Implementation of StaffReadPlatformService for accessing staff data, including retrieval of staff details, hierarchy, and associated items, using JDBC in the Fineract project.

classes.name: StaffReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of staff data retrieval service with methods for fetching staff details, hierarchy, and associated items.

classes.name: StaffMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet rows to StaffData objects for general staff retrieval.

classes.name: StaffInOfficeHierarchyMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet rows to StaffData objects for staff in office hierarchy, optionally filtering for loan officers only.

classes.name: StaffLookupMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL ResultSet rows to StaffData objects for staff lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanOfficersInOfficeById
methods.description: Retrieves all loan officers in a specific office by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaffForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves staff for dropdown selection, considering user office hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveStaff
methods.description: Retrieves staff details by staff ID, with access control based on office hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaff
methods.description: Retrieves all staff based on office ID, role filters, and status.

methods.name: retrieveAllStaffInOfficeAndItsParentOfficeHierarchy
methods.description: Retrieves staff in an office and its parent hierarchy, optionally filtering for loan officers.

methods.name: hasAssociatedItems
methods.description: Checks for items associated with a staff member, such as clients, groups, loans, and savings accounts.
